summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the six first-created angels, their threefold responsibility over all creation, completion and collective rejoicing, the denial of superior worthiness, the obligation concerning the other recipients, past and future revelation, the positive-or-negative doubt question, and all final assurances. The simplified wording retains these claims without adding doctrinal conditions or weakening negation or necessity. The variant notes are consistent with the supplied project reports and distinguish corrections, editorial restorations, preserved fragments, and mediated version evidence without replacing the working reading. Acceptance is limited to source fidelity and disclosure on the supplied evidence; it does not authenticate unseen images, certify editions or handwriting, or establish exhaustive collation or a unique interpretation.
